answer_1.quote: We train a model to generate decompositions of complex political claims ...
answer_1.outputs: yes‑no subquestions (binary questions) derived from claims

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE and BERTScore to evaluate generated questions ... The Pearson coefficient between human judgments and the automatic metrics ranges from 0.42‑0.54 ...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a user study in which we ask an annotator to rate how useful a set of questions (without answers) are to determine the veracity of a claim ... annotators rate on a Likert scale from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate usefulness/helpfulness of the subquestion set on a 1‑5 Likert scale.
